title: CONTAINSSTRING ignores case and accepts wildcards
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "Case 1", CONTAINSSTRING ( "abcd", "bc" ), "Case 2", CONTAINSSTRING ( "abcd", "BC" ), "Case 3", CONTAINSSTRING ( "abcd", "a*d" ), "Case 4", CONTAINSSTRING ( "abcd", "ef" ) )

source.quote: CONTAINSSTRING is case-insensitive, kanatype-insensitive, width-insensitive and accent sensitive.
source.supports: the documented query returns TRUE TRUE TRUE FALSE
